result.name: account
result.title: Account
result.description: Call when the user says "upgrade", "change plan", "buy", "subscribe", "my account", "current plan", "cancel", "billing", "top up", "add credits", or "buy credits". Opens the SolvaPay billing surface. Pass `view` to pick the landing screen; omit it to let the server pick (no plan → checkout, out of credits → topup, else account). Read-only snapshot — charges happen after the customer confirms. Always include the Manage and Checkout markdown links from the tool result in your reply to the user. To change something, call this tool again with `view`: `account` (manage or cancel), `topup` (add credits), or `checkout` (change plan).

result.name: create_hosted_session
result.description: UI-only; agents should prefer `account` / `activate_plan`. Create a SolvaPay hosted session and return its URL. Pass kind: "checkout" for a hosted checkout URL (fallback when Stripe Elements is blocked) or kind: "portal" for the customer portal URL.

result.name: create_payment_intent
result.description: UI-only; agents should prefer `account` / `activate_plan`. Create a Stripe payment intent for the authenticated customer. Pass purpose: "plan" to purchase a plan (returns { clientSecret, publishableKey, accountId?, customerRef }) or purpose: "topup" for a credit top-up (credits are recorded by webhook after confirmation). A topup may carry autoRecharge so the card entered for the top-up is saved as the auto-recharge funding source.

result.name: process_payment
result.description: UI-only; agents should prefer `account` / `activate_plan`. Process a Stripe payment intent after client-side confirmation and create the SolvaPay purchase. Call after confirmPayment resolves to short-circuit webhook latency.

result.name: attach_business_details
result.description: UI-only; agents should prefer `account` / `activate_plan`. Attach business purchase details to a payment intent and retrieve the computed tax breakdown.

result.name: set_renewal
result.description: UI-only; agents should prefer `account` / `activate_plan`. Toggle auto-renewal on an active purchase. Pass enabled: false to cancel (access continues until period end) or enabled: true to undo a pending cancellation.

result.name: get_history
result.description: UI-only; agents should prefer `account` / `activate_plan`. Load product charge history and account-wide credit activity for the authenticated customer. Charges come from purchases for this product; credit activity is every credit event on the account.

result.name: activate_plan
result.title: Activate plan
result.description: Call when the user says "activate" and a specific `planRef` is known. Free plans activate immediately; usage-based plans activate when the balance covers usage; paid plans open checkout. Requires `planRef` — to list or pick a plan, call `account` with view: "checkout".
